description: Defines the SubscriptionHandler class and related data structures for managing subscriptions, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, and publishing data, as well as thread management and external dependencies.

classes.name: SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: Manages client subscriptions, handles subscription requests, unsubscriptions, and data publishing, with thread control and access management.

classes.name: subscription_keys
classes.description: Represents a subscription key consisting of a path and attribute, with equality comparison.

classes.name: UUIDHasher
classes.description: Hash functor for UUIDs used in unordered_map.

classes.name: SubscriptionKeyHasher
classes.description: Hash functor for subscription_keys_t, combining VSSPath and attribute hashes.

methods.name: SubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for subscription management.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Adds a publisher to the list of publishers.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a new subscription for a given channel, database, path, and attribute.

methods.name: unsubscribeAll
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions for a given channel.

methods.name: publishForVSSPath
methods.description: Publishes data for a specific VSS path, datatype, attribute, and value.

methods.name: isThreadRunning
methods.description: Checks if the thread is active.

methods.name: subThreadRunner
methods.description: Function run by the subscription thread.
